none: PAS NLM-7DCA57: Roman Coin: Copy Nummus of House of Constantine from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]ONS[--]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; either a shield in air or an angled D or Delta in left field. Reverse inscription: Blundered [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 12.01mm, Weight: 1.25gms, die axis: 6
